## RemoteTransport interface

Shared HTTP boundary for canonical clients and raw RPC compatibility hooks. Protocol, credential and cancellation handling are identical for both paths; only the consumer's treatment of a valid server error envelope differs.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface RemoteTransport extends ClientTransport
```

**Extends:** [ClientTransport](./contracts_client.clienttransport.md)
